content:
maria: heads up — we saw a 2-3x tail latency blip on gpu-pool-11 around 10:22 UTC during a long-streaming job. spikes only when LRU eviction is enabled (FIFO looks fine). anyone else?

sanjay: saw it too yesterday. repro with long-context T=12k tokens streaming. spikes align with pager churn and increased page faults.

alex: adding a flamegraph and pprof I grabbed to a gist: https://internal/gists/kv-lru-flame. main hotspot is kv_pager::evict_range -> reclaim_chain -> mutex contention. suspicion: LRU reinserts causing repeated re-scans of same slabs.

chris: can you paste the minimal repro? I want to try with FIFO and kernel-selection knobs.

maria: repro script below:
```
# repro
LB_CONTEXT=12000 ./run_streaming_test --batch-size=1 --kv-policy=lru --request-rate=50
```
log snippet:
```
[10:21:38] pager: reclaim started for slab=7 seg=3
[10:21:38] kv: evicting 512 entries (candidate loop=0)
[10:21:38] pager: page-in 16384 bytes took=28ms
[10:21:39] latency(ms)=1200 p50=12 p95=520 p99=1100
```

kv-bot: automated: rolled kv.policy.default=LRU -> FIFO for gpu-pool-11 at 10:24 UTC as part of mitigation :gear: (ci:build/evict-stress-2245)

tina: after switching to FIFO we saw immediate drop in p99, but memory fragmentation increased slightly over 30m. hypothesis: LRU causes high churn under sustained streaming because of reinserts moving items to MRU end, producing long scan windows. FIFO trades tail latency for some fragmentation/growth.

sanjay: also noted a correctness-adjacent failure in debug builds: assertion "kv: reuse after free" during reclaim_scan when eviction and reinserts interleave. looks like a race where tombstone handling isn't atomic with reinsertion. I'll add extra checks and a minimal repro.

alex: profiling notes: kernel selection didn't change hotspots — compute kernels same. but batching heuristics amplify the effect: small batches keep the hot set shifting and LRU continually moves recently used blocks, increasing pager churn. suggestion: add a streaming fast-path that pins recent prefix pages and skips heavy scanning for known append-only sequences.

chris: action items:
- sanjay: add assertion + minimal repro for "reuse after free" and open draft PR (ETA: today)
- alex: run FIFO vs LRU perf matrix across batch sizes (1,4,16) and seq lengths (2k,6k,12k) and log p50/p95/p99 + mem growth (ETA: EOD)
- tina: monitor fragmentation + mem growth for FIFO canary on gpu-pool-11 and push metrics to dashboard (ETA: 2h)

maria: thanks. I'll open a short RFC with proposed fallback: if streaming_metric>0.8 then prefer FIFO + periodic compaction; otherwise LRU. @channel please react with :thumbsup: if you agree.

sanjay: +1

alex: :thumbsup:

tina: :eyes:\"
